resolvedDevelopmentFailures: The initial number-only batch loaded two fixtures while AT markup/module edits were still in progress (missing completion hint/import). Complete-source regression reruns pass both cases; partial-edit results are not final evidence.

The retained draft stress fixture reproduced rebasing a number draft silently after another machine changed its row. The draft now retains the original expected packet/number until the user reviews and re-enters the value.
Processed rows originally hid drafts with no local cancel path. Read-only notices now retain those values and allow cancellation without writing.
Visual inspection found disabled circular AT buttons overlapping progress values. The same disabled node now moves below the ring; ready actions keep their original placement and listeners.
Number-edit regression expectations changed only for the approved Tab/error draft-retention behavior. Existing payload, stock, identity and cancellation checks remain.
scope: WS dates and numbers share draft rendering/clearing. Drafts are scoped by enrollment/record, memory-only, explicitly saved or cancelled, retained on blur/retry/redraw and protected during selection changes.
Existing number correction validation and stock/CPWS/packet/date/order contracts remain. A stale retained number draft cannot silently overwrite an externally changed packet.
AT help describes existing prerequisites, KC, Receive Date defaults and immediate promotion on passing, including backdated attempts. Default pass/fail and promotion rules are unchanged.
Completion state adds only an informational free-level flag; no schema or master-data changes.
Role lists add active/inactive/total counts. The UI blocks deletion for any assigned account and refreshes after a rejected stale delete. Existing server deletion and permission/session rules remain.
limitations: UI uses disposable browser/desktop profiles and synthetic APIs; SQL integration uses its verified disposable cluster.
No live payment, printer, restore, KSIS operation or production restart was exercised in this round.
